│ Which settings layout should the demo app use when someone opens it for the first time on a small laptop screen?

❯ 1. One long page with every setting grouped under clear headings
     Simple to scan, though the page grows long as more settings arrive
  2. Tabs across the top, one for each group of settings
     Short pages, but a setting can hide in a tab nobody opens
  3. A search box first, with the most used settings listed below it
     Quick for people who know what they want, slower for those who browse
  4. Type something.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
